environment.description: Django application deployed on EC2 instances behind a basic Network Load Balancer (NLB). PostgreSQL RDS backend. No WAF configured. NLB operates at Layer 4 (TCP) and does not inspect HTTP content. Authentication via DRF TokenAuthentication. No application-level rate limiting configured (DEFAULT_THROTTLE_CLASSES is empty). Direct HTTPS passthrough to application servers.

config.network: VPC with public subnet, security group allows 443 inbound from 0.0.0.0/0
